io.milvus.common.clientenum

Enum FunctionType

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<FunctionType>
      • io.milvus.common.clientenum.FunctionType
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable, Comparable<FunctionType>

    public enum FunctionType
extends Enum<FunctionType>
    The type of a function used to build a vector index from one or more scalar fields, such as sparse BM25 or dense text embedding.

    • Enum Constant Summary

      Enum Constants 
      Enum Constant and Description
      BM25
      The BM25 sparse vector function, typically built from a text field.
      MINHASH
      The MinHash function, typically built from text fields to produce sparse vectors.
      MOLFINGERPRINT
      The molecular fingerprint function, typically built from SMILES fields.
      RERANK
      The reranking function used in hybrid search.
      TEXTEMBEDDING
      The text embedding dense vector function, typically built from a text field.
      UNKNOWN
      The function type is not specified or unknown.
